_note: C-32 auction cost model parameters. DATA, not code. Additive and separate from scoring-config.json, so no scorecard is re-versioned. REC values; not Michael-confirmed.

min_net_usd_for_yes.note: no universal profit floor (ADR-0012); small fast auction flips may qualify

fast_turn_hours.note: time to cash at or under each bound sets fast_24h / fast_48h

slow_inventory_days.note: expected days to sell above this sets slow_inventory, separately from the fast flags

payout_lag_days.note: days from sale to cash in hand when the input does not give one
